_note: Starting points, not tuned by ear. Keys under params are the control shortnames (see the page: hover a knob label). Anything not listed stays at its default. 'tag' is the FX category from tools/npc_profile/roster.py. At most two tags are stacked per line there; stacking here means loading one then adjusting, or a combo entry.

scenarios.name: Clean
scenarios.desc: No processing.

scenarios.name: Machine: servitor
scenarios.desc: Thin, crushed, slow buzz: a lobotomised drone. Mix below 1 keeps the words readable.

scenarios.name: Machine: cogitator / tech-priest
scenarios.desc: Light metallic ring plus a short echo: a human voice with machine in it.

scenarios.name: Machine: machine spirit
scenarios.desc: Higher ring rate and a tight ringing echo: an inhuman presence in the machine.

scenarios.name: Vox channel: vox-caster
scenarios.desc: Band-limited, driven, slightly crushed: a vox transmission.

scenarios.name: Vox channel: ship intercom
scenarios.desc: Narrow and crunchy, a little tremolo for a dropping signal.

scenarios.name: Helmet: sealed suit
scenarios.desc: Boxy mid-range, a little bass build-up, a tiny resonant echo like a small shell.

scenarios.name: Helmet + vox (astartes over comms)
scenarios.desc: The helmet box then a narrower, driven channel on top.

scenarios.name: Ethereal: ghost / psyker
scenarios.desc: Long soft reverb, faint waver, a slow echo. The true 'rises before the word' swell is the offline reverse reverb, not in this page.

scenarios.name: Monstrous: daemon / huge creature
scenarios.desc: Pitched down, heavy lows, driven, a touch of ring and small-room reverb. Mix stays 1 because pitch shifting delays the wet path.

scenarios.name: Cavernous: vast hall
scenarios.desc: Big bright-then-dark reverb and a slap echo so the room itself rings.

scenarios.name: v2 Machine: tech-priest (partly human)
scenarios.desc: Voice-box buzz under a human voice: band-limited, squeezed, 60 Hz ring at low mix, a tiny slapback. Reports 1-3. Starting point.

scenarios.name: v2 Machine: servitor (flat buzz)
scenarios.desc: Dalek-style 30 Hz ring at near full mix, hard compression, thin band. Fully mechanical. Pair with a flat monotone TTS delivery.

scenarios.name: v2 Machine: Dalek (1963 recipe)
scenarios.desc: The documented one: 30 Hz ring at 100%, mid band, diode-ish distortion. Keep vowels long in the source line.

scenarios.name: v2 Machine: Necron (cold, ancient)
scenarios.desc: Down two semitones, tight resonant comb (7 ms, rings near 140 Hz), faint high ring, subtle crush, long dark tomb reverb. Check the comb does not howl on vowels.

scenarios.name: v2 Vox: ship intercom
scenarios.desc: Clean-ish ship comm: 500 Hz to 8 kHz, radio-AGC squeeze (14:1), light drive, faint voice-gated hiss. Middleware-style numbers.

scenarios.name: v2 Vox: field radio
scenarios.desc: Walkie-talkie: 300 Hz to 3 kHz, hard squeeze, grit, 10-bit crunch, hiss that ducks under the voice.

scenarios.name: v2 Vox: long range, noisy
scenarios.desc: Narrow, crushed, a lot of hiss: a distant or degraded transmission. Hurts clarity, use sparingly.

scenarios.name: v2 Vox: data-slate / hologram
scenarios.desc: Archival playback: band-limited, slow wobble, crunch, steady hiss, a touch of overdrive. Wow/flutter is only approximated by tremolo for now.

scenarios.name: v2 Helmet: Astartes
scenarios.desc: Down two semitones with a low shelf for chest weight, a short tight slap and a small boxy reverb: sealed helmet, not a room. Reports advise 1-3 semitones only.

scenarios.name: v2 Helmet + vox (heard over the comm)
scenarios.desc: Astartes helmet voice then pushed through a comm band with a little hiss.

scenarios.name: v2 Ethereal: psyker
scenarios.desc: A doubled, drifting voice in a big dark space with a slow phase sweep and a long echo. Reverse reverb is not in this chain yet.

scenarios.name: v2 Ethereal: Aeldari
scenarios.desc: Subtle: de-essed, faint chorus, slow phaser, a bright hall at low mix. Formant shift is not available yet.

scenarios.name: v2 Monstrous: daemon (layered)
scenarios.desc: Voice dropped seven semitones, mixed 75% with the raw voice (the pitch path is about 20 ms late, so the two layers double each other), drive, a short echo.

scenarios.name: v2 Monstrous: brute (Ork, giant)
scenarios.desc: Four semitones down, chest weight, heavy drive, compressed, with the top rolled off. Pitch shift is not formant-preserving, so check consonants.

scenarios.name: v2 Cavernous: light hall
scenarios.desc: Deliberately restrained: a short pre-echo and a modest hall. The game's own Wwise reverb will add more, so keep this light.

scenarios.name: Phaser test: classic 4-stage (Phase 90 style)
scenarios.desc: Four allpass stages, slow sweep, 50/50 blend, no feedback: the plain guitar phaser. Phasers show best on sustained, harmonically rich sounds, so speech needs a faster rate or more feedback to read as a phaser.

scenarios.name: Phaser test: 8-stage with feedback (Small Stone style)
scenarios.desc: Eight stages, positive feedback: a deeper, more resonant swirl.

scenarios.name: Phaser test: hollow (negative feedback)
scenarios.desc: Four stages with negative feedback: a nasal, hollow sweep.

scenarios.name: v3 Vocoder: servitor / Cylon (16 bands)
scenarios.desc: Channel vocoder, 16 bands, 110 Hz pulse carrier with some noise for consonants, thin band, squeezed. The Cylon-style flat mechanical voice. Best with a monotone source line.

scenarios.name: v3 Vocoder: crude robot (8 bands, low carrier)
scenarios.desc: Eight bands and an 80 Hz carrier: blunt, clearly synthetic, still readable.

scenarios.name: v3 Vocoder: tech-priest blend (24 bands, 60% wet)
scenarios.desc: 24 bands at 60% wet over the dry voice: a human voice with a machine layer on it, words stay clear. Carrier 70 Hz.

scenarios.name: v3 Vocoder: ghost whisper (noise carrier)
scenarios.desc: Carrier is all noise: a breathy whisper with the words intact, plus reverb. For psychic / Veil voices.

scenarios.name: v4 Machine: Pasqal-style stack (starting point)
scenarios.desc: Layers for a dense multi-voice texture: voice at -12 and +7 semitones, a 16-band vocoder at 60% on a 90 Hz carrier, a little metal-box ring, squeezed. A starting point for matching the in-game Pasqal sound, not matched yet. Mix 1 (the layers are delayed on purpose).

scenarios.name: v4 Monstrous: daemon (harmonizer layers)
scenarios.desc: The reports' daemon recipe: the voice with copies at -7 and -12 semitones under it, heavy drive, low-mid weight, a short echo. More menace than the single pitch shift.

scenarios.name: v4 Helmet: Astartes with EQ
scenarios.desc: Helmet voice with the reports' EQ fixes: down 2 semitones, mud cut around 300 Hz, +5 dB high shelf above 3 kHz to bring the consonants back, a little metal-box ring.

scenarios.name: v4 Machine: vox-grille servitor
scenarios.desc: Vocoder voice through a box-like resonance with a small chance of dropout: a servitor speaking through a damaged grille.

scenarios.name: v4 Vox: hologram / failing recording
scenarios.desc: Wow and flutter for the failing tape or projector, narrow band, crunch, hiss and random dropouts.

scenarios.name: v4 Vox: field radio with dropouts
scenarios.desc: The v2 field radio with the transmission cutting out now and then (after the speaker sim, as the reports advise).
